additional_info.subject: Note RC-TR
additional_info.body: There was a Mainbreaker_QA1 fault on the device. Field inspections revealed that MA1 was attempting to close but was unable to close QA1. The entire electrical circuit of MA1 was checked, but no issues were observed. As a result, MA1 was replaced, and the fault was resolved.
